remarks: This refreshed and sun-filled 2-bedroom, 1-bath corner unit offers comfort, convenience, and standout features rarely found in the complex. Enjoy brand new flooring, fresh paint, new stainless steel kitchen appliances and an open-concept living/dining area-ideal for entertaining. One of the unit's most desirable features is its private balcony (not shared!), offering beautiful views of downtown Stamford and Long Island Sound in the distance. Both bedrooms are spacious with great natural light. Ample hallway storage and a full bath complete the interior. This unit also comes with two assigned parking spaces-a valuable bonus for city living. This high-rise building offers a suite of amenities that enhance your lifestyle: Gated entry with 24/7 security, Outdoor swimming pool, Fitness center, Laundry room & basement storage, Visitor parking. Monthly HOA includes: heat, hot water, cooking gas, basic cable, and ground maintenance. Just a short walk to downtown, Metro-North, I-95, shops, restaurants, and entertainment, this condo blends comfort, convenience, and value. Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a private corner unit in a prime location!
